item.title: Alembic Pharma clears USFDA inspection at Vadodara bioequivalence facility with nil observations
item.description: Alembic Pharmaceuticals has reported that its Vadodara facility passed the recent inspection by the United States Food and Drug Administration with flying colors. Conducted from August 31 to September 10, 2026, the inspection resulted in zero observations, leading to a clean report from the USFDA and highlighting the facility's commitment to excellence.

item.title: India crosses 80 lakh HPV vaccinations in nationwide cervical cancer prevention drive
item.description: India has now administered over 80 lakh HPV vaccinations to girls. This significant milestone strengthens preventive healthcare and protection against HPV infection. The nationwide campaign, launched in February, targets fourteen-year-old girls for free vaccination. The Gardasil-4 vaccine is available at government health facilities across the country. Parental consent is mandatory for this voluntary immunization program.

item.title: Japan court dismisses IHH subsidiary Northern TK Venture's damage claims against Daiichi Sankyo
item.description: NTK, a subsidiary of IHH Healthcare Berhad had earlier filed a claim at the Tokyo District Court seeking damages from Daiichi Sankyo, alleging that the Japanese firm had obstructed NTK's efforts to complete its open offers to acquire shares in Fortis Healthcare Limited and its step-down subsidiary, Fortis Malar Hospitals Limited.

item.title: Marengo Asia Hospitals raises Rs 400 crore from LeapFrog Investments
item.description: Marengo Asia Hospitals has secured Rs. 400 crore funding from LeapFrog Investments. This capital will fuel expansion into tier one and two Indian cities. The company plans to double its hospital bed capacity to 4,000 beds. Marengo Asia Hospitals aims to consolidate its leadership and enter new geographies. This investment reinforces LeapFrog's commitment to healthcare platforms across Asia.

item.title: Novartis India MD Amitabh Dube appointed as OPPI president
item.description: Amitabh Dube has been appointed as the new president of OPPI for a two-year term. Dube currently serves as the Country President and Managing Director of Novartis India. He brings nearly three decades of extensive pharmaceutical industry experience to his new role. Dube expressed his privilege to lead OPPI during India's healthcare transformation. The former president, Bhushan Akshikar, expressed confidence in Dube's leadership.

item.title: AIG Hospitals to invest Rs 2,000 crore in Visakhapatnam for 1,000-bed campus
item.description: AIG Hospitals will invest two thousand crore rupees over five years. A thousand-bed greenfield multispeciality hospital will be built in Visakhapatnam. The first phase with six hundred fifty beds should open by October 2028. This facility will offer over fifty medical and surgical specialities. The project also includes a nursing college and research laboratory.

item.title: Park Medi World to expand hospital network across north India, add 1,450 beds by FY28
item.description: Park Medi World plans to add 1,450 beds by FY28, expanding its northern India network. The hospital chain focuses on Tier 1, 2, and 3 cities for efficient scaling. Acquisitions will target hospitals with 200-250 beds, expandable to 350. The company reported record net profit and revenue in FY26. Park Medi World is also adopting cleaner energy systems across its facilities.
